transport: 2-wire maintained dry contact · open-circuit voltage: ? · current: ? · terminals 3 and 4 on generator terminal block TB3; "See the ATS manual for cable size" (TP-6984 Fig 1-21); ATS-side contact rated 0.5 A @ 125 VAC / 2 A @ 30 VDC, #12–24 AWG, max 213 m (TP-6345 Fig 2-15 p.23)
gotchas: TP-7092 §2.3.3: "Close the switch to start and run the generator set. Open the switch to stop the generator set." Controller must be in AUTO (§2.3.8).
Opening the contact runs the "smart engine cooldown", 5 min default, ends early on temperature (§2.3.6); set any ATS cool-down to zero.
No Kohler document read states the voltage or wetting current on 3/4; a forum claim of "12 V" is `unverified`. Fault shutdowns latch until OFF is pressed (§2.5.2).
